work.title: Image Intake Validation Utilities
bullets: Implemented Python validation routines for image intake records, checking required metadata fields and flagging inconsistent dimensions for downstream processing.
Maintained regression tests for malformed records and updated error messages to support diagnosis of recurring intake failures.

projects.title: Baseline Image Classification with Intensity Histograms
bullets: Implemented a baseline image classifier using NumPy intensity histograms and a linear support vector classifier in scikit-learn.
Compared histogram configurations on a validation split and inspected held-out confusion matrices to identify recurring errors between visually similar categories.
